title: Google
subtitle: Connect your Google account for read-only Gmail, Calendar, and Drive. Sending stays human.
statusHelp: Tokens stay in the OS keychain. Dream never puts them in the prompt.
readonlyNote: Read-only in this cut. Send, delete, and share are refused.
connectHelp: Set DREAM_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Open the URL, then paste the loopback redirect or code.
